title: MetaVul: Agentic Harness Discovery for Vulnerability Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.40721v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM agents are increasingly used to automate vulnerability detection, but reliable detection is challenging because agents must distinguish subtle, security-relevant fixes from benign code variation. While underlying LLM capability has improved significantly, the accuracy of the agent still depends heavily on the harness: the code that defines the scaffolding around the LLM. Harnesses are typically fixed, and largely hand-written, limiting adaptation to evaluator feedback. Additionally, when harnesses are static, improvements on one dataset or model may not transfer to others. To address these challenges, we introduce MetaVul, a self-improving framework for harness discovery in vulnerability detection. Starting from a seed structured reasoning scaffold, MetaVul uses a workflow-based optimization loop to iteratively refine the harness using feedback from paired vulnerable and patched functions, while preserving the structured reasoning

translated_title: MetaVul：面向漏洞检测的智能体框架自动发现方法
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体正被越来越多地用于自动化漏洞检测，但可靠的检测仍然极具挑战性，因为智能体必须从良性的代码变化中辨别出细微的、与安全相关的修复。尽管底层LLM的能力已经显著提升，但智能体的准确性仍在很大程度上取决于框架——即围绕LLM定义脚手架结构的代码。这类框架通常是固定不变的，且大多由人工编写，限制了其根据评估器反馈进行自适应调整的能力。此外，当框架是静态的时候，在某一数据集或模型上取得的改进可能无法迁移到其他数据集或模型上。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了MetaVul，一个用于漏洞检测中框架发现的自我改进框架。MetaVul从一个种子结构化推理脚手架出发，利用基于工作流的优化循环，借助成对的漏洞函数与修复函数所产生的反馈来迭代地优化框架，同时保持结构化推理。
tldr: MetaVul提出了一个用于漏洞检测的自我改进框架发现机制，通过基于工作流的优化循环，利用成对的漏洞函数与修复函数的反馈迭代优化LLM智能体框架，克服了传统固定手工编写的框架难以自适应评估反馈、且改进难以跨数据集和模型迁移的局限。
en_tdlr: MetaVul introduces a self-improving harness discovery framework for vulnerability detection that iteratively refines LLM-agent scaffolds through a workflow-based optimization loop using feedback from paired vulnerable and patched functions, overcoming the limitations of fixed, hand-written harnesses.
